weights_rationale: Offer is current_buyer framing - Stefano replied asking for operators looking for ground partners in Piedmont/Liguria - so destination_overlap is positive and gets the top weight (25); Italy mentions in lead descriptions are a strong filter for relevance. niche_match is second (15) because specialties are concrete and high-signal: wine tourism in Langhe/Monferrato, truffles, food and gastronomy. country is capped at 10 because source_markets is in low_confidence_fields (inferred from EN/IT/FR/DE site language menu, no direct evidence). niche_penalty stays small (5) because Let's Visit is itself a niche specialty operator (wine+food); we still want to penalize wholly orthogonal niches like polar, dive, surf, safari, ski-only.
prospect_summary: Let's Visit Network is an Italian incoming tour operator headquartered in Nizza Monferrato (Piedmont), specialising in experiential wine and food tourism across Piedmont and Liguria. The team builds tailor-made itineraries and curated experiences across four destination clusters: Langhe & Monferrato, Turin, the Maritime Alps & Monviso, and the Palms & Flowers Riviera. Signature products include vineyard tastings, truffle and cheese discoveries, hazelnut experiences, and cultural visits in the UNESCO-listed wine hills. The site is published in English, Italian, French and German, which suggests a European and North American inbound focus. Ideal B2B partners are boutique tour operators and luxury travel advisors who sell northern-Italy wine, food, and cultural programmes to clients in the UK, US, DACH region and France.
